subject: general
question: Find the volume of a sphere whose diameter is 6 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **Diameter** = 6 cm → **Radius (r)** = 3 cm.

**Volume of Sphere** = (4/3) × π × r³

Volume = (4/3) × π × 3 × 3 × 3 = 4 × π × 9 = 36π cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 36π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Diameter (d)** of the sphere = 6 cm

**Formula Used:**

Radius (r) = d ÷ 2

**Volume of Sphere (V)** = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fb64ecb3590b914dc4b6e38f42679f25b67856fcdd022ebfc0306deefa09924.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius (r) = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × π × (3)³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × π × 27

⇒ Volume = 4 × π × 9

⇒ Volume = 36π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 36π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is given by the formula: A = 4πr².

Volume of Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere; its volume is: V = (2/3)πr³.

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere

Includes the curved surface and the flat base area: TSA = 3πr².</p
